policy.visualSource: Image-generated painted PNG figures only; no shape-drawn troop fallback.
policy.directions: At least 8 authored directions for every unit; 16 for foot polearms governing interception.
policy.animation: Full character animations are required: walk at least 4 phases, preferably 8; attack windup/contact/recovery; hit at least 2; death at least 4; applicable special actions at least 4 phases per direction. A heading sheet or single pose is reference-only.
policy.completion: Only explicit visually verified per-action direction AND phase counts, alpha, proportions and complete source figures count. Mirroring, repeated source cells, unreviewed aliases and draft ready-frame fallback do not count.
policy.draftFallback: A complete painted ready frame may keep a draft troop visible while missing actions remain reported; it does not certify readiness, reload or action artwork.
